name: Adaptive Video Game Music Benchmark
description: A multi-objective benchmark and dataset for evaluating conditional autoregressive models that generate adaptive video game music given game states and objectives.
evaluation_method: human evaluation (preference/quality) and objective audio metrics (e.g., FAD, reconstruction/coverage metrics) combined as multi-objective scoring
general_score_metric: human preference rate / composite multi-objective score (quality + alignment to game state + diversity)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific dataset for adaptive game-music generation used in research on conditional audio generative models but not broadly adopted outside that community.
notes: Subjective evaluation is important (human preferences); small / domain-specific dataset; non-LLM audio benchmark; multi-objective evaluation makes single-number comparisons difficult.
